title: ShotTimelineAsset manifest (asset.json)
description: Self-describing manifest for a ShotTimelineAsset — a portable, multi-track shot decomposition produced by kais-shot-timeline and consumed by downstream canvases (e.g. @kais/infinite-canvas). The manifest carries the schema_version, source provenance, generator identity, the inventory of 5 canonical data JSON files, and the inventory of canonical media files (video + 3 stems). Producer (Phase 2): exporter writing asset.json into the asset directory. Consumer: any reader that wants to understand the asset without external docs.
$comment: Graceful-degrade rule (SPEC-02 / CONTEXT D-02): The schema is intentionally strict (additionalProperties: false on every object). Strictness at validation time is what forces explicit version bumps. The CONSUMER, however, must be lenient at RUNTIME: on an unknown or newer schema_version, ignore unknown fields, render the known parts, and emit a warning — do NOT reject or crash. New field = minor version bump (old consumers degrade gracefully). Breaking change (rename, semantic shift, removal) = major bump, and MUST be documented in the prose SPEC migration section. Semver-lite: major[.minor], e.g. "1" or "1.1" — NOT full semver (no patch component, no pre-release tags).

schema_version.description: Asset contract version, semver-lite (major[.minor]). Examples: "1", "1.1", "2.0". Non-examples: "v1", "1.1.1", "". Consumer MUST graceful-degrade on unknown/newer versions: ignore unknown fields, render known parts, emit a warning — do NOT reject. New field = minor bump; breaking change (rename/semantic shift/removal) = major bump (document migration in SPEC.md).

asset_type.description: Asset kind discriminator. Always the literal "shottimeline" for this contract — lets a future reader distinguish this asset kind from others sharing a directory.

source.description: Provenance of the original source video.

video_filename.description: Original source video filename (basename, e.g. "《小江湖》第03话：….mp4").

duration_sec.description: Source video duration in seconds (from ffprobe).

generator.description: Identity of the tool that produced this asset.

version.description: Tool version (any string — semver, git SHA, build id).

data.description: Inventory of the 5 canonical data JSON files. Each value is a path relative to the asset root.

shots.description: Relative path to shots.json (no parent traversal, no drive letters, must end in .json).

media.description: Inventory of canonical media files. Paths are relative to the asset root and MUST follow the canonical naming (CONTEXT D-03): video.mp4 at root or one directory deep; stems under stems/{vocals,drums,other}.wav. The producer's pre-canonical layout (stems/htdemucs/<stem>/{vocals,drums,bass,other}.wav) is NOT accepted here — the Phase 2 exporter renames to canonical before writing asset.json. bass.wav is intentionally excluded (consumer frontend only uses 3 stems).

video.description: Relative path to the canonical video file. Must end in video.mp4 (optionally under one or more directory segments). Rejects ../video.mp4, /abs/video.mp4, video.avi.

stems.description: Canonical 3-stem WAV inventory (bass is excluded — consumer only renders vocals/drums/other).

vocals.description: Relative path to vocals WAV. Canonical: stems/vocals.wav.

drums.description: Relative path to drums WAV. Canonical: stems/drums.wav.

other.description: Relative path to other WAV. Canonical: stems/other.wav.
